name: horizon
description: Root test aggregator: farm/checks.py detects checks at the repo root only, so this script is what makes the server and ui suites (plus the infra/host/deploy-*.sh stubbed-PATH shell harness) run at the guardrail gate. The Python suite is wired via pytest.ini. test:e2e runs the Playwright suite (e2e/) end to end in demo mode — farm/checks.py detects and runs it separately, skipping with a warning on hosts without Chromium installed (npx --prefix e2e playwright install chromium, once). HZ-128: `type: module` is here because domain/js/lifecycle.js is the only JavaScript at the repo root with no nearer package.json — without it Node reparses it as ESM and warns on every server/e2e test run. verify-base-build.mjs is what makes the production-base UI build a real gate check (infra/host/test/deploy.test.sh stubs npm, so it never runs a real vite build).

scripts.test: npm --prefix server install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix ui install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix ui run test && bash infra/host/test/deploy.test.sh && node ui/scripts/verify-base-build.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix server install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix ui install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix e2e install --no-audit --no-fund && npx --prefix e2e playwright install chromium && npm --prefix e2e test
